scripts.build:prod: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/manifest.json','utf8'));if(m.manifest_version!==3||!m.background?.service_worker)throw new Error('Invalid production manifest');console.log('Production manifest OK')"
scripts.test:i18n: npm run test:i18n:unit && npm run test:i18n:browser
